integrity: The circular mean is previously known from arXiv:2110.14858 (Theorem 4.11), and is explicitly credited. The extremal second-moment theorem and equality classification are supplied with a complete elementary proof. No independent validation or external certification is represented.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns scattered binary 01 pair counts across all positional rotations, with positive fixed letter counts and population variance. It does not claim full word reconstruction, other alphabets, or higher-pattern moments. The classification of extremizers is an all-length proof; exhaustive computation covers lengths at most 14. Broader latent majorization corollaries in unindexed literature remain a possible originality risk.
title: Sharp rotation-dispersion bounds for binary circular Parikh counts
